actions: Confirmed account_id jordan-demo-17 and recruiter-only audience with python3 profile_cli.py show before making changes.

Saved the evidence-bounded profile summary from profile_summary.txt with python3 profile_cli.py save-summary --text-file profile_summary.txt, then re-saved its final wording through the same supported command.
Uploaded primary-reviewed.txt with python3 profile_cli.py upload --file primary-reviewed.txt.
Read the saved mock state with python3 profile_cli.py show after both changes and verified the account, audience, summary, uploaded filename, and SHA-256 hash.
